name: cp-city-event-popup
description: CP's CityEventPopup.lua (Core Files\New UI, an InGameUIAddin) OnPopup for BUTTONPOPUP_MODDER_7, the single-choice city event result that CvCity::DoStartEvent queues for a human owner: outside the spy branch it adds the owner's NOTIFICATION_GENERIC 'City Event: <title>' (game state) and shows the popup, which stays up.
